/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && [ -f package.json ] && sed -n '1,200p' package.json || true && sed -n '1,120p' config.json"

npm test
cp config.json .cli-check.json
node src/cli.js set .cli-check.json service.retries 3

node src/cli.js set .cli-check.json service.name '\"api\"' --dry-run
printf '%s\\n' '--- file ---'
sed -n '1,80p' .cli-check.json
rm .cli-check.json"
